title: Open scalar comparison with unit, tensor and composition normalization
statement:
Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] and $A\to B$ a map of finite commutative rings. On ordinary unbounded constant-ring pro-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], put $S_T=-\otimes_A^LB$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], let $U_T$ be scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and use the scalar adjunction [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. Use exact open adjunctions $j_!^R\dashv j_R^{-1}$ [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero] and the canonical $\lambda_j:j_B^{-1}S_X\cong S_Uj_A^{-1}$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. The common-right-adjoint comparison defines a B-linear natural isomorphism $\beta_j:S_Xj_!^A\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!^BS_U$. Its inverse is the open adjunct of $\lambda_j^{-1}\circ S_U(\eta_j^A)$. Under scalar restriction and the canonical tensor identifications, beta is the open projection isomorphism at the constant module B [lem-cbc-extension-zero-projection-formula]. For $A\to B\to C$, these beta maps compose to beta for $A\to C$ under balanced scalar associativity [lem-sfb-successive-derived-quotient-normalization], including identities.

For arbitrary $K\in D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ and $Q\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ let $\gamma^R$ be the forward open projection isomorphism $(j_!^RM)\otimes_R^LN\to j_!^R(M\otimes_R^Lj_R^{-1}N)$. The following two routes from $S_X(j_!^AK\otimes_A^LQ)$ to $j_!^B(S_UK\otimes_B^Lj_B^{-1}S_XQ)$ agree: (i) $S_X\gamma^A$, then $\beta_{j,K\otimes j_A^{-1}Q}$, then $j_!^B$ of the scalar monoidal comparison and $\lambda_j^{-1}$; (ii) the scalar monoidal comparison, then $\beta_{j,K}\otimes1$, then $\gamma^B$. Thus beta preserves the unit-normalized open tensor map, for arbitrary Q.
